comment: Converts Fusicoccin P to Fusicoccin J.

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 1 revised SMARTS/SMILES, added secondary reaction described in literature.

reactions.description: O-prenylation on glucose moiety of diterpene glycosides intermediates of fusicoccin A biosynthetic pathway.
Reverse O-prenylation on glucose moiety of fusicoccin P to give fusicoccin J, main reaction of the biosynthetic pathway.
Reverse O-prenylation on glucose moiety of fusicoccin H to yield 6′-O-(1,1-dimethyl)allyl fusicoccin H. This reaction is observed in vitro and it is 50 times slower than the main reaction.
